purpose: Fail-closed contract for future accepted-record decisions and a future immutable prepared dataset manifest. This file contains no candidate acceptance or split assignment.

manifest_format.split_policy: Every record must have exactly one of train, val, or test. No implicit val_aux or unknown split is allowed in the training manifest.

source_payload_path_policy: The referenced original bytes must be staged under ml-pipeline/source_candidates for external sources or equal the frozen train image path for inherited records; resolved paths and SHA-256 are verified by preflight.

candidate_group_policy.group_review_status: Must be source_group_reviewed before acceptance; registry and manifest group_id must equal the pinned group-closure component_id.
candidate_group_policy.historical_holdout_family_never_train_or: Only val may be used, and it must be reported as historically linked rather than independent; never train/test.
candidate_group_policy.quarantine_source_label_conflict_compone: Never accepted under this contract revision.
candidate_group_policy.historical_exact_copy_not_a_new_independ: Never accepted as a new-source record; retain at most the separately reviewed frozen-base record.
candidate_group_policy.internal_match_pending_dedup_group_and_l: Never accepted until a later versioned review ledger resolves the duplicate group.

directory_integrity_policy: Every file directly present in a train/val/test image or label directory must correspond to exactly one manifest row; unknown files and subdirectories block the gate. data.yaml split paths must point exactly to images/<split>.
historical_quarantine: No inherited record in the pinned 71-record legacy visual quarantine or nine inherited cross-split components may be used in the new base pending separate object-level review and a new contract revision.

legacy_class_29_migration.coverage: Exactly one registry decision per frozen clean_v2 manifest record whose label contains class ID 29.
legacy_class_29_migration.locked_policy: A locked acceptance registry may contain no pending legacy migration decisions.
legacy_class_29_migration.migration_join: A migrate decision must reference one accepted inherited_train_record with matching frozen image SHA, annotation SHA, and group ID; its final class_ids must not contain legacy ID 29.
legacy_class_29_migration.exclude_policy: Excluded or quarantined legacy records must not appear in the new training manifest.

reviewed_annotation_artifact.boxes_xywh: List of [class_id,cx,cy,width,height] normalized to the corrected source image after EXIF orientation. These rows must equal the prepared YOLO label rows within the declared tolerance.

accepted_record_requirements.split_eligibility: Must explicitly contain the assigned manifest split.
accepted_record_requirements.identity: The registry record ID must be unique and the manifest's source hashes, class ID, and group ID must match it exactly.
accepted_record_requirements.review: Reviewer, timestamp, rationale, annotation provenance, and evidence references are mandatory.

class_mapping_policy.legacy_namespace: IDs 0-28 and names must exactly match frozen dataset_clean_v2/classes.json positions 0-28.
class_mapping_policy.legacy_cucumber_id_29: Forbidden in the new head. Each old cucumber unknown record requires source-backed migration or explicit exclusion; no automatic healthy inference.
class_mapping_policy.new_class_ids: Append only, contiguous, unique IDs after 28; each entry must declare source_semantics_accepted, evidence_references, minimum_train_groups, minimum_val_groups and minimum_test_groups before the plan is locked.
class_mapping_policy.yaml: data.yaml names must exactly match the ordered canonical class mapping; mapping/object keys must be contiguous IDs starting at zero.

provenance_and_split_policy.source_hash: SHA-256 of immutable original image bytes or explicitly documented source payload.
provenance_and_split_policy.annotation_hash: SHA-256 of the source annotation or accepted reviewed annotation artifact.
provenance_and_split_policy.prepared_hashes: SHA-256 of the prepared image and YOLO label file.
provenance_and_split_policy.groups: Known related views, source-identified plant/session groups, exact duplicates, and accepted near-duplicate constraints stay within one split. Unknown physical identity must remain explicitly recorded; absence of a match is not proof of independence.
provenance_and_split_policy.historical_holdout: No record linked to a historical val/test family may enter new train or be claimed as a new independent test.
provenance_and_split_policy.conflicts: Conflicting publisher-label groups remain quarantined until source evidence resolves them; no diagnosis is inferred from pixels by the validator.

review_evidence_policy: These pinned review ledgers are constraints only, never acceptance decisions. A changed audit requires a new contract revision and hash lock.
test_manifest_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON for the test records sorted by record_id, using sorted object keys and compact separators.
non_goals: This contract does not accept any of the 55,992 candidate records.
This contract does not build, train, export, quantize, or package a model.
This contract does not make the historical clean_v2 test an independent field test.
This contract does not certify agronomic diagnosis correctness or field generalization.
